coordinateSystem: WGS84 -> local metres, X east, Y up, Z south
waterDatumNote: Median DEM samples >65m inside mapped river, fixed visual datum; not current river level.
limitations: OSM completeness and timestamps vary; not surveying data.
Unmapped building heights are deterministic style estimates; estimated feature IDs are preserved.
The Hongyadong and Qiansimen superstructures are custom approximate models, not scans.
Tree placements and windows are decorative, not inventory data.
River level and bridge deck heights are visual estimates; not current hydrology or bridge survey.
No navigation or real restaurant attribution is implied.
The coarse DEM is lowered within the Hongyadong oriented bounding rectangle in the renderer to fit the terraced landmark; this is a visual correction, not a terrain survey.
Decorative lower facade windows continue across visible foundation walls; they do not verify real basement floors.
Bridge and footpath levels are incomplete; drawn surfaces are not a routable pedestrian graph.
Landscaping density, shrubs, lamps, vehicles and boats are decorative styling, not real-time or surveyed features.
